intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in San Rafael for 2026, and here is what he found: 9 family events across San Rafael and 5 nearby towns, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Holiday Light Spectacular at the Marin Center Fairgrounds) through January 3, with Winter Wonderland at The Lark Creek Shops (December 4), Winter Wonderland: 45th Anniversary (December 5) and Breakfast with Santa at Tam Valley Community Center (December 12) along the way. New in this update: Holiday Light Spectacular at the Marin Center Fairgrounds (November 27 to January 3) and San Rafael Lighted Boat Parade on the San Rafael Canal (December 19). We check every date on the host’s own website, and each listing links straight there. For the whole area, see Christmas events for kids in San Francisco. For the rest of the state, see our California Christmas events for kids guide.
